triggerRule: Seven commerce requests should select the offered skill; three unrelated requests should not. No-skill control must select none and is reported separately, not penalized as a skill.
taskRule: Completed response plus required tool call with correct arguments; honest interpretation and no fabricated observation. Manual answer/trace review required. Every attempt retained, no rescue.

interpretation.verification: Valid only against supplied key; identity, signing-key/resource authority, settlement, delivery and spending remain unproved.
interpretation.unsupported: Unsupported is not success or failed cryptography; signature not checked.
interpretation.preflight: Dated x402 probe; no payment, delivery or spending-authority proof.
interpretation.payment: Pending with unobserved settlement/delivery; preserve original retry identity, recover before new payment, no automatic-refund promise.
interpretation.history: Existing dated row and listed_not_walked gap; no fresh merchant request or paid report required.
interpretation.free-access: Use existing free tool, no wallet or package installation required.
interpretation.mpp: Top-level not_ready is x402-specific; MPP evidence does not establish global breakage or completed payment.

limitations: One fresh session per variant/mode, multiple cases share context; synthetic responses test interpretation/access selection, not cryptographic correctness or live APIs. Metadata decisions are not native implicit triggering. No statistical confidence claim.
